name: CI -> cluster: Jenkins enum -> Groovy RCE -> kubelet -> etcd
goal: From unauthenticated Jenkins enumeration to script-console RCE and then into the Kubernetes control plane.
preconditions: Jenkins (and ideally a k8s cluster) reachable.
impact: CI code execution, cluster pod inventory with env secrets, etcd secrets read.

steps.purpose: Map jobs, build names, env hints — the recon layer for the console.
steps.on_fail: Console blocked -> keep enum evidence; pivot to kubelet next.

steps.purpose: Groovy console execution = CI-plane RCE (build credentials, cloud keys in env).
steps.on_success: Read Jenkins env + creds store paths -> often k8s SA tokens.
steps.on_fail: Console authed -> default creds (auth shelf) or CVE-era deser (documented variant); continue to cluster probes.

steps.purpose: Kubelet PodList exposes pod env vars — often includes secrets/tokens.
steps.on_fail: 10250 blocked -> 10255 read-only (infra/Kubelet read-only 10255 metrics) or apiserver anon (infra/Kubernetes API anonymous version disclosure).

steps.purpose: Cluster store read: all secrets if exposed on :2379.
steps.on_success: Cluster-level secret harvest = full infrastructure compromise narrative.
steps.on_fail: etcd secured -> document kubelet findings; try docker daemon (devops_infra shelf).

recon.name: CI surface census
recon.how: Probe Jenkins paths (/people, /asynchPeople, /script, /securityRealm) and status pages.
recon.signal: Jenkins UI or API without auth.

recon.name: Kubelet dual-port probe
recon.how: 10250 (authed API) vs 10255 (read-only) — often one is open.

recon.name: etcd version probe
recon.how: GET /version on :2379 reveals exposure; keyspace read follows.

recon.name: Service inventory side-doors
recon.how: Consul/Nomad/Portainer/Docker APIs on adjacent hosts (devops_infra shelf) complete the CI->infra map.

variants: kubelet exec via 10250 (needs POST auth — documented gap)
pivot_hints: CI creds -> repo access -> source chain (recon-secrets-to-cloud)
docker daemon -> devops_infra shelf for container escape narrative
